name: list_union_variant_hint_float_arm
description: UNION BURN-DOWN — the array union_variant_hint made OBSERVABLE. list<int | float> over [1.5, 9007199254740993] (2^53+1). Element 0 only try_casts on the FLOAT arm (as_i64 rejects 1.5), so coerce_array carries the float arm as element 1's ctx.union_variant_hint; try_cast_union tries the HINTED arm FIRST and float try_casts 2^53+1 at score 0, returning IMMEDIATELY — before the int arm that PRECEDES it. f64 cannot represent 2^53+1, so the emitted value is 9007199254740992. A hint-less coercer would pick the int arm and emit 9007199254740993, so this is the case that proves native reproduces the hint rather than approximating it. Paired with list_union_variant_hint_int_arm (the mutate-to-diverge twin). want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
